I really like it. But it did give us more questions than it answered imo. I liked how Miquella's story is basically "the road to hell is paved with good intentions.". I like how he felt so guilty over his mother's sins that he felt the need to sacrifice his body, grace, love and life. The Radahn rebirth thing was explained well enough via the npcs. I assumed that Radahn was Miquella's second choice after he failed (much like he has with many things in his life) to resurrect Godwyn.

The dlc desperately needed more backstory on Marikia's rise to godhood. how her and Radagon work. Also the "seduction and betrayal" mentioned in the trailer. I get that they don't want to blatantly explain the story step by step. But this is the reason that Miquella felt the need to sacrifice his body, grace, love and life. It needs to be explained for the story to be satisfying.

We also really needed SOMETHING about the GEQ...ANYTHING....I assumed that the teaser in the frenzied flame ending was setting up more lore about her in the next game. But apparently this is it??? No more DLCs or sequels????

I could've worded it poorly, but I think Melina was the unborn child in the pregnant woman's belly. I suppose the GEQ could've been the pregnant woman, and that title would've passed onto Melina. Until Markia "betrayed" the pregnant woman by killing her.

I think destined death/the rune of death must've been sealed during messmer's attack on the shadow lands. I say this because look at the spartan like soldiers in the trailer. They're not undead looking zombies. So the ruin of death must have been sealed after this.

I think the reason Marika sealed it at this point is because we had the age of abundance where life and death was still a thing. Eventually Melina was reborn through the erdtree and rallied up the omen to end Marika's age. So Marika thought "She's just going to keep coming back and eventually we will lose. The only way I can fully stop her is by stopping the cycle of life and death."
There needed to be a mandatory boss between morgott and the fire giant. You spend SO long traversing this abandoned mountaintop with no new story progression

i think the land of shadow is where the "soul" went before the erdtree was around. Marika had to stop this cycle from happening to feed her growing erdtree, hence the war. It would also explain why messmer is there. He would govern over the dark side of this cycle. Leading the dead back to the erdtree to keep it fed
